children: RNS Number : 2734V  Murray International Trust PLC  17 September 2026

The Company announces that, on 17 September 2026, it sold from treasury 200,000 Ordinary shares of 5p each (the "New Shares") for cash at a price of 368.0 pence per share.  The New Shares rank pari passu with the existing Ordinary shares and dealings are expected to commence on 21 September 2026.

Following this issue of shares, the total number of Ordinary shares in issue is 596,066,377 with each Ordinary share holding one voting right and there are 50,993,638 Ordinary 5p shares remaining in Treasury.

The total number of voting rights in the Company is 596,066,377 and this figure may be used by shareholders as the denominator for the calculations by which they will determine if they are required to notify their interest in, or a change to their interest in the Company, under the Disclosure Guidance and Transparency Rules.
